title: pytest -n against a cold shared cache: a country aggregate built from a partial wave set caches as fresh, so data tests flake indistinguishably from regressions
dedup_status: partial: step (1) nominally landed via #891 (ef50e5dd7) -- parquets carry lsms_cache_waves -- but by design it records the waves the build was ASKED for (the union), not the waves that contributed rows (CLAUDE.md: a zero-row wave would otherwise be permanently unsatisfiable), so it cannot distinguish 'built from 2 of 7' from 'asked for 7'; step (2) collides with that decision; step (3) is absent (no 'cache incomplete' skip in tests/conftest.py or conftest.py).
priority_why: A flake that mimics a data regression costs a full investigation each time, but no served number is wrong and the mechanism is still a hypothesis.
summary: The issue's mechanism is unverified: the failing assertion was `assert nan == 5570.0` for household 101332, i.e. the household WAS present with a null Expenditure, which does not obviously match 'missing waves' -- it looks more like a panel-id/updated_ids mapping not applied in one worker's build. 9a828b0cc (09-22) retired the default-mode Uganda cache purge from conftest, so the suite no longer purges a shared cache, but a cold shared root under -n 32 still has N workers building the same table.
evidence: country.py:4392-4420 (#891 manifest semantics), CLAUDE.md 'Wave coverage is carried by a manifest'; grep -i 'incomplete|concurrent build' tests/conftest.py conftest.py -> none; git log 9a828b0cc
approach: First diagnose: reproduce with 2 processes building GhanaLSS food_acquired cold into one private root and diff the resulting var/ parquet against a serial build (row count, households with null Expenditure). If a partial aggregate is real, add a per-build lock on var/<table>.parquet.tmp (writer-side) rather than a second manifest. Separately, run the suite as the Makefile does (-n with --dist=loadfile, LSMS_BUILD_WORKERS=1) which already serialises same-file builds.
verify: Two-worker cold repro equals serial build; test_panel_id_collisions passes under -n 32 on a cold private root. CACHE COST: a writer lock in to_parquet is in the fingerprint (to_parquet is deliberately included, _build_registry.py:112) -> corpus re-warm; place it in the same window as #908/#969.
